notes.title: Gnomer v2.7.5 - The Bow Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] The Knight’s bow releases automatically when held fully charged, so you can focus on dodging gnomes.
[*] Fixed collisions on Stick Gnome.
[*] You can now exit build mode using ESC.
[/list]

Good hunting Knight !

notes.title: Gnomer v2.7.4
notes.content: This update improves user experience. Minor bugs were fixed.

notes.title: Gnomer is out !
notes.content: [h1][b]Meet Gnomer.[/b][/h1][p]It’s a rogue-lite where you crack open booster packs and turn effect cards into glorious mayhem. Light your arrows on fire. Chain lightning through gnomes. Make enemies detonate. Stack it all until the screen looks like experimental art. Then dive deeper by choosing your next level on a branching map. Build towers to help you shoot gnomes and heal. Unlock new characters, weapons and more ways to make crazy builds. Repeat until the gnomes perish![/p][p]Beware: the thrill of ripping a booster pack open and making a build is highly addictive. The game just scratches the brain in the right spot![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="EQNTBleNmws;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Meet the playable characters!
notes.content: [p]In Gnomer, you can play as three different gnome busters, each equipped with their own pair of tools.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45118710/e2eac042f543a4780241d210fa4e10bdfede7758.png"][/img][/p][h1]Knight[/h1][h3]Bow[/h3][p]The Knight is equipped with the standard-issue bow B0W-1. The longer you [b]charge the shot[/b], the more damage it deals and the farther it flies.[/p][p]Arrows shot from bow are [b]able to pierce[/b] through gnomes without any effect card.[/p][h3]Sword[/h3][p]The Knight performs a frontal sweep that deals damage and knocks enemies back.[/p][p][/p][h1]Ranger[/h1][h3]Crossbow[/h3][p]It [b]automatically shoots[/b], but the shots are weaker than the Knight’s charged bow.[/p][p]Arrows shot from crossbow are [b]unable to pierce[/b] through gnomes without any effect card.[/p][h3]Focused Blow[/h3][p]Unleash a focused blow that delivers precise, concentrated damage to a single direction.[/p][p][/p][h1]Hunter[/h1][h3]Boomerang[/h3][p]Throw a boomerang that pierces through every gnome in its path, then catch it on its return before you can throw it again.[/p][h3]Area Clear[/h3][p]Hunter performs a swift sweep all around him that damages enemies and knocks them away.[/p]
